drugs.name: maropitant (injectable)
notes: 1 mg/kg SC or IV once daily (SID), up to 5 consecutive days (Plumb label tables)
Dogs: SC from 2 months; SC or IV from 4 months for acute vomiting
Cats (≥4 months): label treatment of vomiting 1 mg/kg SC or IV SID ≤5 days
SC may be painful — refrigerating injectable may reduce pain (Plumb)
Hospital stock concentration: 10 mg/mL (Prevomax / Cerenia injectable) — product strength, not stated in Plumb monograph text
Not for motion sickness at this injectable dose
drugs.source: Plumb's Veterinary Drug Handbook, 10th Edition — Maropitant monograph pp. 799–801 (cats continue p. 802). Dog inj 1 mg/kg SC (± IV); cat inj 1 mg/kg SC or IV q24h ≤5 days. Chemistry/Synonyms lists Cerenia® and Prevomax®.

drugs.name: maropitant (tablets — vomiting)
notes: Dogs: prevention of acute vomiting — 2 mg/kg PO once daily (SID)
PO dose higher than SC because of lower oral bioavailability (Plumb)
Hospital tablet strengths: 16 mg and 24 mg (product stock — not listed in Plumb monograph text)
Not the motion-sickness regimen (8 mg/kg)
drugs.source: Plumb's Veterinary Drug Handbook, 10th Edition — Maropitant monograph pp. 799–801 (cats continue p. 802). Prevention of acute vomiting — Tablets — 2 mg/kg PO once daily.

drugs.name: maropitant (tablets — motion sickness)
notes: Dogs: prevention of vomiting due to motion sickness — 8 mg/kg PO once daily (SID)
Up to 2 consecutive days (Plumb)
Give on empty stomach or with a small amount of food; do not feed a full meal prior to travel (Plumb client info)
Do not use injectable 1 mg/kg interchangeably for motion sickness
Hospital tablet strengths: 16 mg and 24 mg (product stock)
drugs.source: Plumb's Veterinary Drug Handbook, 10th Edition — Maropitant monograph pp. 799–801 (cats continue p. 802). Prevention of vomiting due to motion sickness — Tablets — 8 mg/kg PO once daily up to 2 consecutive days.

drugs.name: maropitant (tablets / PO — cat)
notes: Cats: prevention of vomiting, including motion sickness (extra-label) — 1 mg/kg SC or PO (Plumb)
OFF-LABEL relative to Cerenia tablets (dog-only oral licence); injectable is labelled for cats
Do not conflate with Plumb CKD line of 4 mg/cat (NOT mg/kg) PO q24h
Hospital tablet strengths: 16 mg and 24 mg (product stock) — score carefully in small cats
Also consistent with iCatCare CKD 2026 Table 4: 1 mg/kg SC, IV or PO q24h
drugs.source: Plumb's Veterinary Drug Handbook, 10th Edition — Maropitant monograph pp. 799–801 (cats continue p. 802). CATS — Prevention of vomiting, including from motion sickness (extra-label): 1 mg/kg SC or PO. Optional concordant: iCatCare CKD 2026 Table 4 (1 mg/kg SC, IV or PO q24h).
